_attackbench.note: attackbench benchmark scope v1 — the ATT&CK technique IDs VARVEL's emulation surface is measured against. Initial set: the 17-row detection-priority matrix in varvel-kimi/research/SOTA-VALIDATION-2026-08-25.md §2.5 (24 distinct IDs; rows that span multiple IDs are split here, one entry per ID).
_attackbench.source: varvel-kimi/research/SOTA-VALIDATION-2026-08-25.md §2.5 (synthesis of CISA/NSA/FBI/partner advisories + MDDR 2025 + MITRE Evals Round 6/7 public scope)
_attackbench.caveat: IDs are the STANDARD ATT&CK mappings of the documented behaviors — NOT lifted verbatim from each advisory's own ATT&CK table (doc §2.5 caveat + §6 honesty note 2). OPERATOR STEP before any published coverage claim: verify each ID against the advisory PDF's own ATT&CK table, and pull current round definitions from the evals results site (unreachable at research time).
_attackbench.nonClaim: VARVEL is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or tested by MITRE. This catalog is a private benchmark scope; nothing here is or may be called 'MITRE-tested' (doc §4 item 4). ATT&CK is MITRE's knowledge base; tactic names/IDs are used as the industry-standard vocabulary only.
